title: russian attack kyiv kills one triggers fire damages high rise building 2026 09 03
text:
Sept 3 (Reuters) - A Russian attack ​on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv ‌on Thursday killed one person, triggered a fire and badly damaged a ​high-rise residential building, officials said.
The ​city's military administration said on ⁠Telegram that one person had ​been killed in the evening attack.
Mayor ​Vitali Klitschko, writing on Telegram, said the ninth floor of a high-rise residence ​had been damaged. Fifteen people ​had been evacuated from the building in a ‌district ⁠just outside the city centre.
Video published on unofficial Telegram channels showed a large fireball rising skywards. ​Unofficial channels ​said ⁠the building had been struck by a jet-powered ​drone.
Klitschko said six people had ​been ⁠wounded in earlier strikes on the capital, which has been subject ⁠to ​more than a ​week of sustained attacks.
